blocks.text: The official portrait shots of the 2026 Miss International delegates are out, and they are stunning. The pageant released the images on social media on Tuesday evening, Nov. 17, delighting pageant fans with a generous serving of face cards. All of the 73 participants posed in plain black tops of different cuts, against a gradient background in an ombre-effect from indigo to pink. But they sported a variety of hairstyles, and wore different earrings. The Filipino photo and video team Klickboxstudios, headed by lensman Raymond Saldaña, produced the glam shots. The group has been working with Miss International for years already. […]... Keep on reading: Miss International 2026 delegates serve face in official portraits
